values: BeeQ Exercise B — pairwise IQP-ZZ graph discovery

Interpretation: no pair survived Holm (45 tests). Stable 10q improved MCC, but selected paths differed in every outer fold. Five Y-randomizations are exploratory only; use --resume --y-replicates 200 on higher compute. CR8 has 8 molecules and was not used for selection.
